Class ContractInProgress

java.lang.Object
org.engine.game.state.GameState
org.engine.game.state.ActiveGameState
org.engine.game.state.ContractInProgress
public final class ContractInProgress extends ActiveGameState
Game state while players are playing cards in an active contract.
